title: OpenAI says coding agents now perform multi-day research tasks under supervision
friendlyTitle: OpenAI says its agents can now handle several days of research work
summary: OpenAI says it has reached its internal target for an automated research intern: a system able to complete well-defined tasks that would take a skilled researcher several days. The company reports rising agent use, faster code contribution and more experiments, while noting that these measures do not directly equal faster scientific progress.
friendlySummary: OpenAI researchers use several coding agents at once for clearly defined tasks. The company says the agents help write code and run more experiments, while people still choose goals and judge results.
whyItMatters: This is a concrete picture of how frontier labs are reorganizing work around several supervised agents rather than a single chat window. Other teams can borrow the workflow, but should measure completed, validated outcomes instead of treating code volume or agent activity as productivity.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Teams may get more value by giving AI bounded jobs and checking the result. More code and more activity do not always mean better research or better business outcomes.
